name: ARM PISTOL
description:
The Bushmaster Arm Pistol is legally classified as a bullpup pistol, but is also classified as a compact carbine.
Featuring a unique design which allows the user to rotate the reciever to their preferred orientation. This firearm featured a tipping-block bolt system, which was combined with a long stroke piston system similar to the AK47 alongside sharing common parts to the AR-15, good damage in close range which quickly falls off, poor accuracy.
